tasks.title: Email to a friend
tasks.prompt: You are going to a concert next weekend. Write an email to your friend Sam. In your email: say which concert you are going to, ask Sam to come with you, and tell Sam what time you will meet. Write 25 words or more.
tasks.sample: Hi Sam, I am going to a rock concert next Saturday at the stadium. Would you like to come with me? Let me know and we can meet at 7 pm at the entrance. See you, Alex.
